subject: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tina Morales <tina@pulsehealth.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Tina / Aaron —

Thanks for the heads-up about the upcoming renewal window. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan so we can align on term options, the capacity uplift you mentioned in last week's call, and a QBR to review usage, performance, and pricing. High level: 

- Goal: Lock a 12–24 month commitment that supports a +30% token throughput headroom for Peak periods and preserves the option to burst.
- Timeline: propose sign-off by 2026-12-20 to keep implementation in January.
- Key stakeholders: Tina (Product), Aaron (Finance), Marissa (CS lead), Kimberly (Security/Contracts).

Next steps from our side: Marissa will validate run-rate and staffing impact; Kimberly will surface any contract controls we should pre-clear; I’ll prepare two term/pricing options (12m standard / 24m discount + burst) for your review. Could you share 2–3 windows for a 60-minute QBR next week or the week after? We’ll come prepared with a short usage readout and a proposed MA P (mutual action plan).

Attached a draft Renewal_Playbook and a short checklist we use internally.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com]
[Attachment: Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tina Morales <tina@pulsehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Karthik — thanks, this is timely. We're definitely planning to increase capacity: our product team expects a ~35% uptick in tokens starting Feb after a new feature launch. A few quick items from our side: 

- We need clarity on peak burst pricing vs. committed baseline.
- Compliance: can you confirm if the Private deployment option (VPC) remains on the table for a phase-in?

QBR windows that work for our execs: 2026-11-17 10:00–11:00 ET, 2026-11-18 14:00–15:00 ET, or 2026-11-22 09:00–10:00 ET. Aaron is looped for finance-side questions.

Also, please include any capacity run-rate that shows the marginal cost of burst vs committed tokens.

Thanks —
Tina Morales
Director of Product, PulseHealth
[tina@pulsehealth.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Tina Morales <tina@pulsehealth.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T13:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Karthik / Kimberly — looping in my recommended ops play: based on current usage patterns (evening-emphasized peaks, median seq length ~120 tokens), initial modeling supports a 30–40% committed uplift with an optimized burst pool. I've attached a quick run-rate workbook and a small proposal for staging (commit month 1 -> +20%, month 3 -> +35%). 

Action items I’ll take: 
- Finalize capacity_runrate_est.xlsx with marginal burst cost by model family (redwood-ggml / quantized variants).
- Map required SRE onboarding time if PulseHealth opts for Private/VPC testing.

Kimberly — can you confirm if there are any contract clauses we should pre-clear (data residency or retention specifics) so we don't delay the QBR-to-sign timeline?

[Attachment: capacity_runrate_est.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)]

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
[marissa.cole@redwood.com]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tina Morales <tina@pulsehealth.com>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Tina / Aaron — thanks for the windows. We can do 2026-11-17 10:00–11:00 ET. Confirmed for that slot unless you prefer another. Agenda (30–45 min + 15 min buffer): 

1) Quick usage readout (Marissa) — current baseline, projected uplift, and run-rate.
2) Term and pricing options (me) — 12m vs 24m with burst economics.
3) Ops & compliance checklist (Kimberly) — items to clear for VPC/on-prem tests.
4) Next steps / timeline to signature (mutual action plan).

Prep: Marissa will upload the run-rate workbook to the shared Drive tonight; I’ll post two clean pricing options and a draft MA P by EOD tomorrow. Kimberly, if you can share a short list of contract items to escalate to Legal, I’ll include them in the MA P. 

Doc links: HubSpot deal (https://hub.redwood.com/deals/D-2026-1374) and draft renewal playbook (https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2B-renewal-playbook). Also including a DocuSign pre-auth link we can swap into the MA P if you want a faster close: https://docusign.com/r/abc123 (placeholder).

Tina — locking 2026-11-17 10:00 ET for now — please confirm and I’ll send the calendar invite.

Thanks,
—
Karthik

From: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tina Morales <tina@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: PulseHealth renewal kickoff — term options, capacity uplift & QBR scheduling

Karthik / Tina — thanks. 2026-11-17 10:00 ET confirmed on our side. A couple of finance asks for the QBR: 

- Line-item for committed baseline vs expected peak month spend.
- Any one-time onboarding or SRE effort estimates if we try VPC in parallel (high-level $ range is fine).

We’ll plan for the 60-minute slot and expect the MA P and the run-rate workbook ahead of the meeting. Appreciate you coordinating.

—
Aaron Lee
VP Finance, PulseHealth
[aaron.lee@pulsehealth.com]
